about.name: Klaus Hofrichter
body: I paint small abstracts in acrylic and photograph what happens to be in front of me — usually **the dog**, usually dinner. The paintings are made in evenings and on weekends, one at a time, and framed before they are photographed.
The abstracts are *one of one*. There are no prints and no editions of them; when one is sold it is gone, though it stays on the wall here. The photographs are printed to order on archival paper.
Everything on this site was made at home in Texas. If you want to know more about a particular piece, or you want something printed at a size that isn't listed, write to me.

contact.note: Replies usually within a day or two.
